card.name: Linking words before infection lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or 'including' inside a list of infection types, right before the word 'infections' or a named infection. Mostly in warnings about bacterial, fungal, viral infections.

modes.label: Comma in pathogen list
modes.description: A comma after 'bacterial, fungal' or similar, before the next pathogen type and 'infections'.
modes.example: Increased risk of serious bacterial, fungal<<,>> viral, and opportunistic infections, including

modes.label: Linking word before named infections
modes.description: 'and' or 'included' leading into specific infections such as pneumonia or sepsis.
modes.example: The most common infections reported by KESIMPTA-treated patients in the randomized clinical relapsing MS (RMS) trials<< included>> upper respiratory tract infection (39%)

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word 'infection' coming next, and favors other words.
card.plain: It fires on the punctuation or linking word in a list of infection types, just before the next item is named.
